name: silica-host
description: Browser host for emulator cores. Ships a WebAssembly AArch64 core (Silica) that runs real clang-built binaries.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:samples && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:core && node scripts/test.mjs && npm run test:e2e
